rows.text: computes `r8d` as the truncated quotient of `edx` by float `01DFE0BC` (decoded 1.0) when `edx` is greater than 0 (signed), else 0; then, only when byte `+3` of `rcx` AND `0xE0` equals `0x60` (else it returns), takes the qword `+0xF0` of qword `+0xB8` of `rcx` and stores word `01DFE0B4` plus `r8w` at its word `+0x68` and word `+0x66`, and dword `01DFE0B4` (decoded 1) converted to float at its float `+0x78`

multiplies `xmm1` by float `01DFE0BC` (decoded 1.0) and adds 3.141593 (`01CEBC50`) when the product is not below 0.0, or -3.141593 (`00915620`) when it is (`jb`); when byte `+3` of `rcx` AND `0xE0` does not equal `0x60` it returns; otherwise it subtracts from the sum the truncated quotient of the sum by 6.283185 (`01CEBC78`) times 6.283185, then the same added offset, and tail-jumps `002E60C0` with `rcx` unchanged and that result in `xmm1`
when `rcx` is non-null and qword `+0xC0` of `rcx` is non-zero, stores `xmm1` at float `+0x3C` of the qword `+0xF0` of qword `+0xB8` of `rcx`; otherwise returns without work

returns without work unless `rcx` is non-null, qword `+0xC0` of `rcx` is non-null, the dword at that pointer is not -1, its low word is not -1, the row qword `022C6F28` plus the sign-extended word times `0x740` is non-null and dword `+0x284` of that row is non-zero; then sets bit 19 (`bts 0x13`) of that dword when `edx` is non-zero, or clears it (`btr`) when `edx` is zero, and stores it back

returns 0 unless `rcx` is non-null, qword `+0xC0` of `rcx` is non-null, the dword at that pointer is not -1, its low word is not -1, the row qword `022C6F28` plus the sign-extended word times `0x740` is non-null, dword `+0x284` of that row is non-zero and the call at `002EA780` + 0x45 (with `rcx` = the row) returns non-zero; then returns 1 when `002EA910` called with the incoming `rcx` returns 1 and 0 otherwise (`sete`)

returns 1 unless `rcx` is non-null, qword `+0xC0` of `rcx` is non-null, the dword at that pointer is not -1, its low word is not -1, the row qword `022C6F28` plus the sign-extended word times `0x740` is non-null, dword `+0x284` of that row is non-zero and the call at `002EA910` + 0x40 (with `rcx` = the row) returns non-null; in that case tail-jumps `003E2C00` with that pointer as `rcx`
calls `0026C330(rdx, 00267E10(r9))`, then `0026A1A0(rdx, 0)`, then `00357DE0` with the four incoming arguments `rcx`, `rdx`, `r8`, `r9`, and tail-jumps `0026C120(rdx, 4)`
calls `0026C330(rdx, 00267E10(r9))`, then `0034BE50` with the four incoming arguments `rcx`, `rdx`, `r8`, `r9`, and tail-jumps `0026C120(rdx, 4)`
calls `00267F90(r9, 0)`, then `0026C330(rdx, 00267E10(r9))`, then `0034BE50` with the four incoming arguments `rcx`, `rdx`, `r8`, `r9`, and tail-jumps `0026C120(rdx, 4)`
calls `00267F90(r9, 0)`, then `0026C330(rdx, 00267E10(r9))`, then `0026A1A0(rdx, 0)`, then `00357DE0` with the four incoming arguments `rcx`, `rdx`, `r8`, `r9`, and tail-jumps `0026C120(rdx, 4)`
converts `xmm0` to double, clears its sign bit with the mask `01CEBD80` (`andps`), converts it back to float and returns the `minss` of that absolute value and `xmm1`

adds 6.283185 (`01CEBC78`) to `xmm0` while it is below -3.141593 (`00915620`), then adds -6.283185 (`00915624`) while it is above 3.141593 (`01CEBC50`); returns 0.0 when the result equals 0.0; otherwise when `edx` is 0 adds 6.283185 to a negative result, when `edx` is 1 adds -6.283185 to a positive result, and returns the value (unchanged for any other `edx`)
